decision_note: Intentionally blank until human reviewer chooses Path A, B, C, or D.

paths.title: Path A — Zero-Cost Verified Public Stack (Immediate Consolidation)
paths.summary: Unify the 3 parallel repo builds into a single deterministic Python build pipeline, expand club depth-chart scraper from 13 to all 32 official NFL club domains, and track paper-only originated lines every Tuesday/Friday/Sunday.
paths.unlocks: 100% 32-club 1st–4th string injury coverage + multi-week prospective paper validation.
paths.cannot_unlock: Cannot unlock live capital tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) or SGP copula gates because closing odds & PBP remain absent.
paths.risk: Low — zero licensing cost, zero hallucination exposure.

paths.title: Path B — Play-by-Play + Participation Analytics Upgrade (nflverse / NGS)
paths.summary: Add 2019–2026 play-by-play EPA/play, success rate, snap counts, and player game logs to compute exact within-game SGP & player-prop copula correlations (N >= 1,800 games) and positional WAR backup drop-offs.
paths.unlocks: Resolves UC-01..UC-04 (Gate G6 empirical correlations) and replaces team-level PF/PA with opponent-adjusted EPA.
paths.cannot_unlock: Still requires closing sportsbook lines for Gate G3 (CLV) and Gate G4 (vig-adjusted ROI).
paths.risk: Low-Moderate — must pin upstream release hashes and keep NFL.com cross-checks.

paths.title: Path C — Licensed Odds & Closing-Line Backtest Stack (Recommended for Competition)
paths.cost: ~$50–$199/mo Licensed Odds API + Path B PBP
paths.summary: Combine Path A (all 32 club depth charts) + Path B (multi-season PBP/snap logs) + timestamped opening/closing spreads, totals, and player prop lines across >=3 regulated sportsbooks (2022–2026).
paths.unlocks: Unlocks ALL 9 validation gates (G0–G8), real CLV/ROI grading, and Bronze/Silver/Gold leaderboard promotions.
paths.cannot_unlock: Does not include real-time sub-second injury wire automation.
paths.risk: Moderate — requires strict timestamp hygiene so post-injury closing lines are never confused with pre-injury openers.

paths.title: Path D — Full Syndicate Real-Time Origination & Execution Desk
paths.summary: Automated 90-minute-pre-kickoff official inactive ingestion, automated 32-club depth-chart diffing, stadium wind/temp telemetry, and live multi-book execution alerts.
paths.unlocks: Captures fleeting injury/inactive pricing windows (e.g., SIG-05 QB2/QB3 & SIG-09/10 prop reallocation).
paths.cannot_unlock: Overkill until Path C proves positive out-of-sample CLV (Gate G3) on historical data.
paths.risk: High engineering & vendor cost if deployed before Gate G3 passes.

prerequisites_register.question: Do our originated NFL fair lines beat closing market spreads/totals after -110 vig?
